function.description: Current position: FEN, side to move, whether the game is over, and the outcome if it is.
function.name: get_board_state

function.description: All legal moves in the current position, in SAN.
function.name: get_legal_moves

function.description: Moves played so far, in SAN, in order.
function.name: get_move_history

function.description: Piece symbols each color has captured so far, in capture order.
function.name: get_captured_pieces

function.description: Stockfish evaluation of the current position from White's point of view: centipawns, or mate-in-N.
function.name: evaluate_position

function.description: Top n candidate moves from Stockfish (MultiPV), best first, with SAN, UCI, and White-POV scores.
function.name: get_best_moves

n.description: How many candidate moves to return.

function.description: Analyze a move: how it compares to Stockfish's best from the same position — centipawn loss, verdict (good/inaccuracy/mistake/blunder), and what was best. Defaults to the player's own last move, which is what 'what was my mistake?' means; pass a color to analyze that side's last move instead.
function.name: analyze_last_move

function.description: Review the whole game so far: every move classified (good/inaccuracy/mistake/blunder) with centipawn loss and the best alternative, plus per-color accuracy scores.
function.name: review_game

function.description: Submit the player's move in SAN (e.g. 'Nf3') or UCI (e.g. 'g1f3'). The engine decides legality: the result says legal or illegal. When the move is legal, the engine opponent replies immediately — the result's engine_move is its answer.
function.name: make_move

function.description: Take back the player's last move. Omit plies unless the player asked for a specific number of half-moves.
function.name: undo

plies.description: How many half-moves to take back. Omit for a normal takeback — the app works out the right number itself.

function.description: Reset to the starting position and begin a new game.
function.name: new_game

function.description: Resign the game. Defaults to the player's own side; pass a color to resign for that side.
function.name: resign

function.description: Save the current game under a name (default 'autosave').
function.name: save_game

function.description: Resume a previously saved game by name (default 'autosave').
function.name: resume_game

function.description: Export the game so far as PGN.
function.name: export_pgn

function.description: Set engine strength: pass exactly one of tier (named level: beginner ~500, casual ~1000, intermediate ~1500, advanced ~2000, maximum = full strength), skill_level (0-20), or elo (1320-3190). Prefer tier unless the user asks for a specific number.
function.name: set_difficulty

function.description: How chatty the agent's commentary is.
function.name: set_verbosity

function.description: Turn move hints on or off.
function.name: set_hints_mode

function.description: Turn spoken (TTS) output on or off.
function.name: set_voice_output
